caption: The drawing depicts a single black cast iron stove set against a plain, light-colored background. The stove is trapezoidal and stands on three slightly splayed legs, with a cylindrical vertical chimney pipe rising from the top. The front of the stove has a small hinged door with a latch and a vent, and a large, round tray extends outward from the bottom front, supported by the two front legs. The shading varies from dark gray to black, giving the stove a metallic appearance. There are no other objects in the image, and the artist’s signature “Geo. V. Vezolles” is written in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Stove
